en: Black‑and‑white printed postcard view of a riverside street in a historic European town. At left a small bridge crosses a shallow river, with wooded hills in the background. On the right stand several multi‑storey townhouses, and above them on a hill rises a large fortified complex with high walls and a tall tower: Schloss Osterburg. Red printed captions at the top identify the location, and a red printer's line appears at the bottom right.
